description: This Java class defines a database schema modification statement for altering existing columns in a table, part of a Liquibase extension for SQL generation.

classes.name: ModifyColumnStatement
classes.description: A class that represents a SQL statement to modify columns in a database table, including schema name, table name, and column configurations.

methods.name: ModifyColumnStatement
methods.description: Constructor initializing the schema name, table name, and columns to be modified.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Returns the schema name of the target table.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the target table.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of column configurations to be modified.
